summary: Review the report response envelope read and all callers. The reader must return every validated exact-attempt candidate and enforce owner role/configuration; reusable author output must match the exact report result_version and created_at_jst, reusable reviewer output must match reviewed_version and reviewed_sha256, and newly completed turns must match both thread_id and turn_id. Ambiguous/stale same-attempt envelopes must not be selected. Test code is explicitly excluded from independent review.
